Name: Milkshakerhino's Brewery
Author: milkshakerhino
Description:
Adds 20 new alcohols as well as some extras to go along with them just to make it feel a bit more immersive. 

I really liked the alcohols added by artisan valley but never enjoyed installing the rest of PPJA and dealing with the overwhelming multitude of new crops, recipes, etc. There are now mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13432]Take It Slow[/url] that makes PPJA more manageable however I felt I wanted something that was a bit lighter. 

I thought I would make this mod for myself and it has been sitting on my hard drive for half a year cause I never got round to using it so I thought I should post it.

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                                                               [/u]

This mod adds a copper pot still for liqueur as well as a handful of crops and trees. 

The crops are Agave, Blue Agave, Barley, Juniper Berries and Raspberries. The trees are an Ume tree and a Pear tree.

The machines are the copper pot still and the drying rack, the copper pot still is used for making alcohols that need to be distilled whilst the drying rack only has one use at the moment, making malt from wheat or barely. 

[u]                                                                                                                                                                                                                               [/u]

[size=3]Item Recipes:[/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3][b]Copper Pot Still-[/b][/size]
[size=2]
Brandy: Put some wine in the still 

Gin: Put some juniper berries (5x) in the still

Mezcal: Put some agave in the still

Rum: Put some sugar in the still 

Saké: Put some rice in the still 

Tequila: Put some blue agave in the still

Triple sec: Put an orange in the still 

Umeshu: Put some ume in the still

Vermouth: Put a grape in the still 

Vodka: Put some potatoes in the still 

Whiskey: Put some wheat malt in the still[/size]

[size=3][b]Keg- [/b][/size]

[size=2]Apple Cider: Apple and yeast[/size]
[size=2]
Framboise Lambic: Raspberry and yeast

Kriek Lambic: Cherry and yeast

IPA: Barley and barley malt

Lager: Wheat malt and barley malt

Perry: Pear and Yeast

Stout: Barley malt

Sparkling wine: wine and yeast

Beer: Wheat and barley malt

Pale ale (same item as the base game): Hops and barley malt
[/size][/spoiler]

If there are bugs I'll probably come and fix them but don't expect new content. I will ensure that the code is up to date when 1.6 comes around but that wont happen instantaneously.
